news.title: Iran’s New Leader Is More Open to Pursuing a Nuclear Weapon, U.S. Intelligence Says
news.summary: The previous supreme leader, who was killed early in the war, had renounced nuclear weapons. U.S. spy agencies believe his son is more interested in building a bomb.
